prompt: Which country was the first outside of Africa to detect a case of mpox in the most recent outbreak? Note that the first human cases were diagnosed in 1970.
answer: Sweden. On 15 August 2024, it became the first country outside Africa to confirm mpox clade Ib in the most recent outbreak.
